cities.name: Bengaluru
cities.tagline: The Silicon Valley of India & Global Tech Anchor

state_policy.department: Dept of Electronics, IT, Bt and S&T, Govt of Karnataka
key_incentives: Reimbursement of lease rental up to INR 15/sq.ft/mo for 2 years in Beyond-Bengaluru clusters (Mysuru, Hubballi).
AI Co-Innovation Fund: Up to 50% matching grant (capped at INR 1 Cr) for joint R&D with academia.
100% electricity duty exemption for 5 years.
Patent filing reimbursement up to INR 10 Lakh for domestic and INR 25 Lakh for international patents.
INR 50,000 per female employee incentive for women workforce inclusion programs.

infrastructure.airport: Kempegowda International Airport (BLR) - Terminal 2, connected to 30+ international hubs
infrastructure.metro: Namma Metro Purple & Green lines operational; Blue line (Airport line) under active expansion
infrastructure.power_reliability: Good in tech corridors (99.5% uptime in dedicated tech SEZs)
infrastructure.source_label: State Infrastructure Telemetry / NITI Aayog Urban Metrics

pros: Deepest talent pool for GenAI, DeepTech, Chip design, and Enterprise SaaS globally outside Silicon Valley.
Unrivalled peer ecosystem — easily hire experienced engineering leadership and principal architects.
High investor confidence and mature vendor/partner supply chain.
cons: High talent competition and salary inflation leading to elevated attrition (15-18%).
ORR traffic congestion increases employee commute friction.
Prime Grade-A commercial rentals are the highest among South Indian tech hubs.
strategic_tradeoffs.recommended_for: Global enterprises building Tier-1 engineering R&D, core platform IP, GenAI teams, and high-complexity innovation hubs.

cities.name: Hyderabad
cities.tagline: The High-Velocity Mega Hub with Pro-Business Infrastructure

state_policy.policy_name: Telangana ICT Policy & TS-iPASS Single Window Act
state_policy.department: Information Technology, Electronics & Communications Dept, Govt of Telangana
key_incentives: TS-iPASS statutory single-window clearance: Approvals mandated within 15-30 days, else deemed approved.
100% reimbursement of stamp duty and transfer duty paid on purchase/lease of land/office.
Power tariff subsidy of INR 1.00 per unit for 3 years.
Recruitment assistance subsidy of INR 20,000 per local employee hired.
Dedicated Mega Project incentives for GCCs creating >1,000 jobs.

infrastructure.airport: Rajiv Gandhi International Airport (HYD) - 158-km Outer Ring Road enables 30-40 min airport commute from Financial District
infrastructure.metro: Hyderabad Metro operational across 69 km; Phase 2 expansion to airport planned
infrastructure.power_reliability: Excellent (dedicated 24x7 industrial power feeders in Cyberabad)
infrastructure.traffic_congestion_index: Moderate (superior arterial flyovers and 8-lane ORR expressway)
infrastructure.source_label: State Infrastructure Telemetry / NITI Aayog Urban Metrics

pros: World-class civic infrastructure with 8-lane Outer Ring Road and minimal traffic choke points compared to Bengaluru.
Aggressive, highly responsive bureaucratic support via TS-iPASS single-window clearances.
Commercial real estate is 15-25% more affordable than Bengaluru ORR with abundant supply in Kokapet.
cons: Slightly smaller immediate talent depth in super-niche deep-tech hardware compared to Bengaluru.
strategic_tradeoffs.recommended_for: Fintech & Wall Street banking operations, Life Sciences/Pharma IT, Cloud Scale engineering, and fast-growing 500+ head count centres.

cities.name: Chennai
cities.tagline: The Engineering & Hardware Capital of South Asia

premier_institutions: SRM Institute of Science and Technology

state_policy.policy_name: Tamil Nadu R&D and Global Capability Centres Policy 2022
state_policy.department: Guidance Tamil Nadu / Industries Dept, Govt of Tamil Nadu
key_incentives: R&D / GCC Training Subsidy: Reimbursement of up to INR 6,000/employee/month for 12 months.
50% stamp duty exemption on long-term lease or purchase of land/office premises.
Intellectual Property Grant: 50% patent filing fee reimbursement up to INR 25 Lakh.
Anchor Unit Capital Subsidy: Up to 25% subsidy for major initial investments in Tier-2/3 extensions.
Electricity duty waiver for 5 years.

infrastructure.airport: Chennai International Airport (MAA) - Metro directly connects Airport terminal to Guindy and CBD
infrastructure.metro: Phase 1 operational across 54 km; Phase 2 (116 km, 3 corridors) under advanced construction with OMR line
infrastructure.traffic_congestion_index: Moderate (OMR elevated corridor & metro work causing localized peak slowdown)
infrastructure.source_label: Guidance Tamil Nadu / Urban Mobility Board

pros: Lowest attrition rate (8-11%) among all Tier-1 Indian tech cities, providing strong team stability and retention.
Unmatched embedded hardware, automotive engineering, and mechanical/embedded software talent from IIT Madras and Anna University.
Real estate and salary costs are 20-30% lower than Bengaluru, delivering massive operating leverage.
cons: Slightly slower lateral hiring speed for cutting-edge consumer-tech product management.
Hot and humid weather during peak summer (May-June).
strategic_tradeoffs.recommended_for: Automotive & Electric Vehicle R&D, Industrial Automation, Life Sciences Clinical Data, Maritime/Supply Chain, and Stable Long-term BFSI Technology.

cities.name: Pune
cities.tagline: The R&D and Product Engineering Engine of Western India

state_policy.department: Industries, Energy and Labour Dept, Govt of Maharashtra
key_incentives: 100% stamp duty exemption for IT/ITES units on lease or sale agreements.
Electricity duty waiver for 10-15 years based on employment tier.
Power tariff subsidy of INR 1-2 per unit for 3-5 years.
Property tax benefits at residential rates rather than commercial rates in municipal zones.
Dedicated R&D patent assistance up to INR 10 Lakh per approved patent.

infrastructure.airport: Pune Airport (PNQ) - New integrated terminal operational; Mumbai Airport (BOM) accessible via 3-hour Expressway
infrastructure.metro: Pune Metro Line 1 & Line 2 operational across 33 km; Hinjewadi-Shivajinagar Line 3 underway
infrastructure.power_reliability: Good (MSEDCL industrial feeds with high UPS/generator backup standard in parks)
infrastructure.traffic_congestion_index: Moderate to High (Hinjewadi junction bottlenecks during peak rush)

pros: Close proximity to Mumbai's financial capital, making it easy to tap senior leadership and institutional clients.
Exceptional engineering culture with 100+ colleges graduating 50,000+ engineers annually.
Pleasant year-round climate and vibrant student/young-professional lifestyle.
cons: Limited direct long-haul international flights from Pune Airport (many executives transit via Mumbai).
Hinjewadi tech corridor traffic during peak morning and evening shifts.
strategic_tradeoffs.recommended_for: Automotive R&D, Heavy Engineering Software, European/UK Financial Services tech back-offices, and IoT/Industrial 4.0 platforms.

cities.name: Gurugram
cities.tagline: The Corporate HQ, FinTech & Strategic Operations Nexus

state_policy.department: Dept of IT, Electronics & Communication, Govt of Haryana
key_incentives: Employment Generation Subsidy: Up to INR 48,000 per employee per year for 5 years.
100% exemption from electricity duty for a period of 10 years.
50% reimbursement of stamp duty on lease/sale agreements for IT space.
Special incentives for green data centres and solar captive power units.
Fast-track clearance through Haryana Enterprise Promotion Centre (HEPC).

infrastructure.airport: Indira Gandhi International Airport (DEL) - Just 15-25 minutes from DLF Cyber City via NH-48 expressway
infrastructure.metro: Delhi Metro Yellow Line & Rapid Metro Gurgaon connect key commercial hubs
infrastructure.power_reliability: Requires 100% backup (diesel gensets/captive systems standard across all Grade A parks)
infrastructure.traffic_congestion_index: High (NH-48 / Cyber Hub peak rush hour)

pros: Best international airport connectivity in South Asia (DEL has direct flights to all major North American and European hubs).
Unmatched talent in strategy, consulting, corporate finance, risk modelling, and legal advisory.
Proximity to central ministries, embassies, regulatory bodies, and North India enterprise headquarters.
cons: Air quality and environmental index dip during winter months (November-January).
Premium Grade-A office rents in Cyber City and Golf Course Road are the highest in NCR.
Requires reliable captive backup power infrastructure.
strategic_tradeoffs.recommended_for: Global Banking & Risk Analytics, Strategy & Shared Services, Management Consulting Knowledge Centres, and Global Supply Chain Headquarters.
